story: A vomited dose and the site's follow-up, asked about when it happens again

messages.text: 1001-148 vomited about 20 minutes after this morning's dose. She did not take another one.
Follow-up on 1001-148: PI advised taking the dose with food from now on; noted in her source documents.
1001-148 vomited after her dose again today. What did we do last time, and does the protocol say to re-dose?
